boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Georgia Institute of Technology
boards.description: Ten currently listed Tech Dining destinations that extend into the evening or later, with hours checked directly against Georgia Tech’s dining pages.

cards.title: Sankranti
cards.subtitle: Tech Square, Georgia Tech
cards.notes: Check the current day before leaving: Tech Dining lists service until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.short_summary: The board’s latest listed Tech Square option.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists Sankranti open until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday; until 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday. Recheck Tech Dining for exceptions.

cards.title: Conference Dining Room
cards.subtitle: Georgia Tech Hotel and Conference Center
cards.notes: Use the posted dinner window as your cutoff: the official dining page lists dinner from 4–11 p.m. daily.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus dinner service listed through 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists the Conference Dining Room open until 11 p.m. daily, with dinner from 4–11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; dinner is listed 4–11 p.m. Check the venue page before visiting.

cards.title: Tech Square Tavern
cards.subtitle: Tech Square, Georgia Tech
cards.notes: Treat it as an evening dining stop and confirm the day’s service before heading over; Tech Dining lists it through 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Tech Square restaurant with listed 11 p.m. service.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists Tech Square Tavern open until 11 p.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 4–11 p.m. daily. Confirm current service and seating details directly with the venue.

cards.title: Moe's Midtown At Georgia Tech
cards.subtitle: Tech Square, Georgia Tech
cards.notes: Plan around the posted 10 p.m. close: Tech Dining currently lists the same daily service window throughout the week.
cards.short_summary: A campus-listed counter-service stop open to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists Moe's Midtown At Georgia Tech open 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Review Tech Dining’s live hours page for changes.

cards.title: Ray's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Tech Square, Georgia Tech
cards.notes: Use the published 10 p.m. close as a practical deadline and verify current hours before making the trip.
cards.short_summary: A Tech Square pizza counter listed until 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists Ray's Pizza open 11 a.m.–10 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 11 a.m.–10 p.m. Check the official hours page for break and holiday changes.

cards.title: Boho Taco
cards.subtitle: Tech Square, Georgia Tech
cards.notes: Aim for Thursday through Saturday if you need the latest listed window; those nights are posted through 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Tech Square option with later Thursday–Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists Boho Taco open until 10 p.m. Thursday–Saturday and until 9 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: until 9 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday and 10 p.m. Thursday–Saturday. Check before departure.

cards.title: Tin Drum Asian Kitchen
cards.subtitle: Tech Square, Georgia Tech
cards.notes: Use it for an earlier evening stop: Tech Dining currently posts daily hours through 9 p.m. at this named location.
cards.short_summary: A campus dining location listed through 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists Tin Drum Asian Kitchen open 11 a.m.–9 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Tin Drum Asian Kitchen | Tech Dining
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 11 a.m.–9 p.m. Confirm current hours on the official Tech Dining page.

cards.title: North Ave Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: East Campus, Georgia Tech
cards.notes: For an on-campus evening meal, use the posted 7 p.m. close as the limit and check Tech Dining for schedule adjustments.
cards.short_summary: A named East Campus dining hall with daily evening hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists North Ave Dining Hall open 7 a.m.–7 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 7 a.m.–7 p.m. Check the official page for break, holiday, or operational adjustments.

cards.title: West Village Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: West Campus, Georgia Tech
cards.notes: Use the official listing to plan an early-evening meal, and reconfirm before going because dining schedules can change.
cards.short_summary: A named West Campus dining hall listed through 7 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Dining lists West Village Dining Hall open 7 a.m.–7 p.m. daily.
cards.access_notes: Listed daily hours are 7 a.m.–7 p.m. Consult Tech Dining’s official hours page before visiting.

cards.title: The Missing T
cards.subtitle: Georgia Tech dining service
cards.notes: Check availability before relying on this option: Georgia Tech announced the service as a late-night ordering concept with 2 a.m. availability.
cards.short_summary: A Georgia Tech-announced late-night ordering concept.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech announced that The Missing T would be open from 8 p.m. to 2 a.m. for late-night dining orders.
cards.source_title: Brittain Dining Hall Closes | Georgia Tech
cards.access_notes: Georgia Tech’s announcement states 8 p.m.–2 a.m.; confirm that the service remains available before making plans.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Georgia Institute of Technology, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe first-weekend route for getting oriented to central campus, campus resources, and Tech Square.

cards.title: Start with a lap around Tech Green
cards.subtitle: First stop: central-campus orientation
cards.notes: Walk the perimeter first, then use the lawn as a landmark while you identify the paths leading toward the Campanile, library, and Student Center.
cards.short_summary: A central outdoor reference point for beginning a self-guided campus walk.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech describes Tech Green as its great lawn and a gathering spot for festivals, exhibits, displays, games, and other campus events.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus space; follow posted event and pedestrian-safety guidance.

cards.title: Use the Campanile as your meetup marker
cards.subtitle: Next: outside the John Lewis Student Center
cards.notes: Pause at the plaza and tiered lawn, then choose a next direction together before splitting off to explore the nearby Student Center or Tech Green.
cards.short_summary: An 80-foot campus landmark beside the Student Center and Stamps Commons.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech identifies the Kessler Campanile as an iconic landmark at the heart of campus, outside the John Lewis Student Center and Stamps Commons.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; access may be affected by scheduled campus events.

cards.title: Get your bearings in the Student Center
cards.subtitle: Then: shared student services and gathering spaces
cards.notes: Look for the John Lewis mural at the second-floor main entrance, then note Tech Rec and the Student Organization Hub for later in the semester.
cards.short_summary: A renovated student hub with dining, meeting, reflection, and student-organization spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech reports that the renovated John Lewis Student Center includes dining, Tech Rec, meeting and reflection spaces, and a Student Organization Hub.
cards.source_title: The New Georgia Tech Student Center, a Place for Students to Reset, Restore, and Refuel
cards.access_notes: Campus building access and individual services can vary; check current Student Center information before visiting.

cards.title: Check what Tech Rec is offering
cards.subtitle: An optional indoor activity stop
cards.notes: Find Tech Rec on the first floor of the John Lewis Student Center and ask staff about current availability before making it a group activity.
cards.short_summary: A recreation venue located in the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech’s facilities procedures identify Tech Rec as located on the first floor of the John Lewis Student Center.
cards.source_title: Campus Procedures for the Use of Facilities & Spaces
cards.access_notes: Availability may depend on programming or reservations; confirm access and any charges with the venue.

cards.title: Make a library stop before the week begins
cards.subtitle: Study-space reconnaissance at the Georgia Tech Library
cards.notes: Walk through Crosland Tower to locate an entrance and service point, so a future study session starts with less searching and more time to settle in.
cards.short_summary: One of the Georgia Tech Library’s main buildings, with visitor hours listed online.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Library publishes visitor hours for its Crosland and Price Gilbert buildings.
cards.access_notes: For visitors not affiliated with Georgia Tech, published hours are Monday–Friday 7:30 a.m.–6 p.m. and weekends 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; verify before travel.

cards.title: Take in the Crosland Terrace view
cards.subtitle: A short outdoor library break
cards.notes: Use the terrace for a daylight reset between indoor stops, then head back through the library rather than treating it as a late-night destination.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor Georgia Tech Library space with published daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Library lists Crosland Terrace hours as 7:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m., seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: Published terrace hours are 7:00 a.m.–9:00 p.m. daily; check the library page for changes or closures.

cards.title: Scope out the Campus Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: An active afternoon option
cards.notes: Visit the CRC during posted building hours and review the available fitness, aquatics, court, and recreation options before planning another visit.
cards.short_summary: Georgia Tech’s recreation center offers fitness, aquatic, court, and other well-being activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech Campus Recreation describes the CRC as offering fitness, aquatic facilities, sports courts, and well-being activities.
cards.access_notes: Summer 2026 building hours are listed as 6 a.m.–8 p.m. weekdays, 9 a.m.–6 p.m. Saturday, and 10 a.m.–8 p.m. Sunday; access rules may apply.

cards.entity_name: The Kendeda Building for Innovative Sustainable Design
cards.title: See a campus sustainability project up close
cards.subtitle: A self-guided visit at 422 Ferst Drive NW
cards.notes: Follow the informational signage through the building’s public areas and use the displays to frame a conversation about materials, water, and energy design.
cards.short_summary: A Georgia Tech-owned building that welcomes public self-guided visits.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech states that the Kendeda Building is open to the public and offers self-guided visits with displays and informational signage.
cards.access_notes: The page lists semester access for all as weekdays 7 a.m.–10 p.m. and weekends closed; confirm current access before going.

cards.title: Extend the walk to Technology Square
cards.subtitle: A final daytime loop east of the Downtown Connector
cards.notes: Walk the district as an orientation exercise, noting the Scheller College of Business, Barnes & Noble, CODA, and surrounding public-facing destinations for later.
cards.short_summary: Georgia Tech’s innovation district east of the Downtown Connector.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech identifies Technology Square as an innovation district east of the Downtown Connector and names Barnes & Noble, CODA, Scheller, the Georgia Tech Hotel, and restaurants there.
cards.access_notes: A mixed campus district; each building and business has its own access rules and hours.

cards.title: Learn the story behind the Ramblin’ Wreck
cards.subtitle: A campus tradition to recognize when it appears
cards.notes: Read up on the gold-and-white 1930 Model A, then keep an eye out for it at major sporting events and student-body functions during the year.
cards.short_summary: Georgia Tech’s official mechanical mascot is a 1930 Ford Model A Sport Coupe.
cards.evidence_claim: Georgia Tech says the Ramblin’ Wreck is a 1930 Ford Model A Sport Coupe and appears at all major sporting events and student-body functions.
cards.access_notes: The vehicle is event-based rather than a continuously displayed attraction; consult the relevant event information for viewing opportunities.
